# Continue Formatter

<!-- Auto-generated by `pnpm docs:formatters`. Do not edit manually. -->

PromptScript compiles your `.prs` sources to native Continue configuration. The main output is `.continue/rules/project.md`. It is not enabled by default, add it to `targets` to use it.

## Enable the Target

```yaml
targets:
  - continue
```

Pick an output version when you need more than the default:

```yaml
targets:
  - continue:
      version: full
```

## Overview

| Property          | Value                        |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------- |
| **Tier**          | Tier 1                       |
| **Main output**   | `.continue/rules/project.md` |
| **Dot directory** | `.continue/`                 |
| **Skills**        | No                           |
| **Agents**        | No                           |
| **Commands**      | No                           |
| **Local files**   | No                           |

## Output Files

| File              | Path                         | Purpose           |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------- | ----------------- |
| Main instructions | `.continue/rules/project.md` | Primary rule file |

## Output Versions

| Version          | Output                                             |
| ---------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `simple`         | Single .continue/rules/project.md file             |
| `multifile`      | .continue/rules/project.md + .continue/config.json |
| `full` (default) | .continue/rules/project.md + .continue/config.json |

## MCP and Hooks

| Block         | Support                        |
| ------------- | ------------------------------ |
| `@mcpServers` | `.continue/config.json` (json) |
| `@hooks`      | Not supported                  |

Native hook reference: <https://promptscript.dev/docs/guides/hooks/>
